discover.caption: Discover: Reading a ranked match
discover.alt: Discover lists 10 of 50 ranked matches for “backend engineer”. The first visible card shows a score of 58.2, SQL and Python skill tags, and a View link. Dark bars hide identifying listing details.
discover.provenance: Capture from the WS-42 Discover browser check, cropped to the results count and first card. Opaque bars cover the specific role wording, employer and location. The capture predates the 22 November 2026 exhibits; the score shown is not a new measurement.

review.caption: Review: What approval does
review.alt: “Before you prepare” says preparation stores an approval request without contacting the employer. Approval queues work rather than submitting. “You remain in control” links to the audit trail.
review.provenance: Capture from the WS-42 Review browser check before preparation, cropped to the two guidance panels. The capture predates the 22 November 2026 exhibits; it shows neither a candidate packet nor an approval or submission outcome.
